# Python inventory fixtures

These are the selected inventory fields from the existing local Pulp
`lightwell-fixture` captures taken on 19 November 2026. The two exact builds are
`3.0.1+rhlw.1` and `3.0.1+rhlw.2`, in the `lightwell` domain's
`python/remediated` distribution, repository snapshot 4.

Filenames, content/artifact hrefs, sizes, and SHA-256 values are unchanged from
the captures. Descriptions and unrelated metadata are omitted. These synthetic
development packages do not establish production inventory or artifact naming.
The tests add multiple-wheel, nullable-metadata, and failure scenarios in memory.
